dedupe_keys.name: geolocated dataset of chinese overseas development finance

description: Geolocated dataset of Chinese overseas development finance is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Rebecca Ray et al. China is now the world’s largest source of bilateral development finance and will likely continue to play a prominent role in sovereign lending through its multi-billion-dollar Belt and Road Initiative. Coverage: global (CN); published in 2021. Formats: Shapefile, Image. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 3863 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC0-1.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
